title: Laboratory method of microbial induced solidification/stabilization for municipal solid waste incineration fly ash
author: Xu, Zheng, et al.

steps.title: Sample and characterize fly ash
steps.instruction: Collect MSWI fly ash from the Hangzhou incineration plant, then perform a series of characterizations: (a) image the raw ash using a FEI Quanta 650 FEG ESEM; (b) determine particle‑size distribution by mechanical sieving for particles ≥0.075 mm and by the hydrometer method for particles <0.075 mm; (c) analyze chemical composition with an energy‑dispersive X‑ray spectrometer (JSM‑5610LV); (d) conduct a Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) according to China EPA HJ557‑2009 by mixing 100 g dry ash with 1 L deionized water in a polyethylene bottle, vibrating at 110 ± 10 times min⁻¹, amplitude 40 mm, temperature 23 ± 2 °C for 8 h; (e) filter the leachate through a membrane disk and quantify metal concentrations (Ca 1852.4 ± 4.3 mg L⁻¹, Zn 108.3 ± 9.1 mg L⁻¹, Cu 9.3 ± 1.3 mg L⁻¹, Pb 7.4 ± 0.9 mg L⁻¹, Cr 10.8 ± 0.6 mg L⁻¹, Cd 0.46 ± 0.07 mg L⁻¹) with an Agilent 7700X ICP‑MS; (f) record physical properties: sand 14.5 ± 2.5 %, silt 69.0 ± 2.3 %, clay 15.8 ± 1.3 %, non‑uniformity coefficient Cc = 28.5, curvature coefficient Cu = 14.6, CaO 44.5 ± 6.6 %, pH = 10.8.

substeps.instruction: Collect 100 g dry fly ash sample.
Image raw ash with FEI Quanta 650 FEG ESEM.
Measure particle size: sieve ≥0.075 mm, hydrometer <0.075 mm.
Determine elemental composition using JSM‑5610LV EDXS.
Perform TCLP: mix ash with 1 L water, vibrate 110 ± 10 times min⁻¹, 40 mm amplitude, 23 ± 2 °C, 8 h.
Filter leachate, analyze metals by Agilent 7700X ICP‑MS.
Document sand, silt, clay percentages, Cc, Cu, CaO content, and pH.

steps.title: Streak and incubate S. pasteurii
steps.instruction: Rehydrate the S. pasteurii strain (CGMCC 1.3687) under sterile conditions, streak it onto solid agar plates prepared with 5 g L⁻¹ peptone, 3 g L⁻¹ beef extract, 20 g L⁻¹ urea, and 15 g L⁻¹ agar (pH ≈ 6.8) inside a laminar‑flow hood, then incubate the plates at 30 °C for 24 h until visible colonies appear.

substeps.instruction: Prepare solid medium (5 g L⁻¹ peptone, 3 g L⁻¹ beef extract, 20 g L⁻¹ urea, 15 g L⁻¹ agar, pH ≈ 6.8).
Streak onto Petri dishes in laminar flow hood.

steps.title: Prepare bacterial suspension
steps.instruction: Select a healthy colony of S. pasteurii and inoculate it into 50 mL of liquid medium (5 g peptone, 3 g beef extract, 20 g urea per 1 L distilled water, pH ≈ 7.0) in an Erlenmeyer flask under sterile conditions; shake at 220 rpm and 30 °C for 24 h, let stand for 1 h, then collect the supernatant and measure its optical density at 600 nm (OD₆₀₀). If OD₆₀₀ > 0.15, the suspension is ready for use.

substeps.instruction: Transfer a single colony to 50 mL liquid medium (5 g L⁻¹ peptone, 3 g L⁻¹ beef extract, 20 g L⁻¹ urea, pH ≈ 7.0).
Incubate with shaking at 220 rpm, 30 °C for 24 h.
Allow suspension to settle for 1 h.
Sample supernatant and record OD₆₀₀; proceed only if OD₆₀₀ > 0.15.
